frame: TransmissionCore; X toward engine, Y transverse, Z up
status: Sensitivity trial: estimated bearing internals and shaft height; fixed source envelope

evidence.bearing_envelope: SNL250:027 gives 2.8346in OD, 1.378in bore, .6693in width. 72/35/17mm is a rounded-metric interpretation within .0012mm of the printed conversions, corroborated by modern SKF1207 ETN9. Two bearings are source-counted; commercial internals are not enumerated by SNL.
evidence.bearing_type: Modern SKF1207 ETN9 has two rows, cylindrical bore, open form. Transfer of that architecture to the historical SKF1207 is conditional; ball diameter/count, races and one-piece cage are estimates, not modern ETN9 reverse engineering.
evidence.bearing_x: Measured saved SH945A flange gap X744.95..821.95:77mm. Center783.45 places a72mm bearing with2.5mm static freeplay each side. Actuated/contact state not claimed.
evidence.shaft_height: Conditional SNL2 scale, original picks [7241,2998] shaft and [7241,2781] drawn clutch axis: relative drop237.9056473mm. Registration/systematic error unresolved.
evidence.shaft_x: Mechanically selected below current bearing station, not source-calibrated. Source-mapped shaft station709.8697 differs by73.5803mm. No calibration refit or historical-fit claim.
evidence.other_geometry: All transverse stations, shaft/pin diameters except source5/8in pin nut and7/16in lock screw nut, lever profiles, key stock, washer profiles, fits and commercial internals are named reconstruction estimates. Brackets, shaft end retention, auxiliary shaft/control rods and brake attachment remain required.
evidence.keys: SNL250 and114 give five M4172 total, including two nested in SNL37 left bracket assembly. This stage installs three main-shaft keys; two auxiliary-shaft keys remain pending.
evidence.threads: Nominal thread envelopes and mating clearance bores, no helical thread geometry. Nut profiles and heights estimated.
evidence.update: Regenerate builder after controls change; metadata is not a live native expression network. Variations must preserve the fixed source bearing envelope.
evidence.cage: Inferred one-piece cage with radial cylindrical ball windows and continuous axial rims. Historical cage form/material remain unquantified. This replaces spherical-window construction after the first candidate failed STEP checks.
